description: Series detail charts (Issue #24 proposal a + b, acceptance criteria 1/2/3). Render on SeriesDetailPage, as inline SVG React components fed by the FEAT-001 helpers: (1) a per-game score-DIFFERENCE bar chart (bars colored by the winning team's team color, height proportional to run differential); (2) a cumulative win/loss trend step/line chart (one line per team, team-colored); and (3) for predictable seasons only, a per-game predicted win-probability trend line (overlaid or adjacent). Each chart MUST have an accessible SVG (role=img + title/aria-label) AND a tabular text alternative <table> conveying the same data (game, scores, diff, winner, and probability where applicable), wired via aria-labelledby/aria-describedby. Team-color coded and legible in dark mode (axes/labels/gridlines use theme CSS variables; bar/line colors use teamColor + readableTextColor for any on-color text). Localize all new strings EN/JA. The tabular alternative must NOT rely on color alone to convey winner/meaning (use text).
steps: Create frontend/src/components/SeriesFlowCharts.tsx exporting a component (e.g. SeriesFlowCharts) that takes { series, bracket, season, predictable, accuracy? } and renders the score-diff bar chart, the cumulative win-trend chart, and (only when predictable AND the season is predictable per isPredictable(season) AND the series has games) the win-probability trend chart. Compute data via FEAT-001 helpers (seriesScoreDiffs, cumulativeWinTrend, winProbTrend).

Implement each chart as inline SVG built from the data arrays (no chart library). Bar chart: one bar per game, x = game number, height proportional to diff (scale to max diff), fill = teamColor(winnerTeamId).primary (fall back to a neutral --muted-based color when winnerTeamId is null). Win-trend: two step/line paths, one per team, stroked in each team's teamColor primary. Prob-trend: a single line of favorite win probability per game (y axis 0.5..0.95 range the model clamps to). Use viewBox + preserveAspectRatio so it scales; keep widths responsive and small enough not to overflow at 375px.

Accessibility: give each SVG role="img" and an aria-labelledby pointing at a localized <title>/heading plus aria-describedby pointing at its tabular alternative. Render a real <table> alternative per chart (visible or togglable; a visible, compact table is simplest and most robust) with localized <caption>/<th> headers: game number, away/home scores, run differential, winner (text, e.g. team abbr + 'won'), and favorite probability (prob chart). Ensure the winner column uses TEXT not color. Use unique ids (useId, strip colons like SeriesCard does) for aria wiring.

Theming + colors: style axes, gridlines, tick labels, and chart frames via CSS classes that reference theme variables (--border, --muted, --ink, --surface, --heading) in frontend/src/styles.css so they are legible in light AND dark. For any text drawn on top of a team-color fill, pick the foreground via readableTextColor(teamColor.primary). Add the chart CSS to styles.css (new .series-flow* classes) and ensure dark palette inherits (variables already switch under [data-theme='dark']).

i18n: add new MessageKey entries to frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts union AND both ja/en MESSAGES tables for: chart section heading, score-diff chart title, cumulative-trend chart title, probability-trend chart title, and the tabular-alternative caption + column headers (game, away, home, diff, winner, probability), plus a '<team> won'/'tie'/'in progress' winner cell phrasing and a localized 'show/hide data table' label if a toggle is used. Default JA. Pull all strings through t().

Wire into SeriesDetailPage.tsx: render <SeriesFlowCharts series={series} bracket={state.bracket} season={season} predictable={isPredictable(season)} /> inside the ready+series branch (e.g. between the result header/teams and the existing game-by-game list), importing isPredictable from @mlb/shared. The charts must render for completed/past seasons (2024/2025 seed) WITHOUT the probability overlay (criterion 2) and WITH the overlay only for the predictable current season.

Add component tests frontend/src/components/SeriesFlowCharts.test.tsx (jsdom + @testing-library/react) asserting: the three SVGs render with role=img and accessible names; the tabular alternative <table> renders and its cell values MATCH the FEAT-001 data (exact scores/diffs/winner text for a fixture series); the probability-trend chart + its prob column render for a predictable in-progress series and are ABSENT for a results-only (2024) series. Reuse/extend frontend/src/test/fixtures.ts (add a predictable in-progress series with games if needed).
acceptance_criteria: SeriesDetailPage shows a score-difference bar chart and a cumulative win-trend chart as inline SVG for any series with games, including the 2024/2025 seed (criterion 2).
For the predictable current season only, a per-game predicted win-probability trend chart is also shown; it is absent for results-only seasons.

Each chart is drawn as SVG (role=img with an accessible name) AND has a tabular <table> alternative conveying the same data, wired via aria-labelledby/aria-describedby; the winner is conveyed as TEXT, not color alone (criterion 1).
Bars/lines are team-color coded via teamColor(); axes/labels/gridlines use theme variables so they are legible in dark mode (criterion 3).
All new strings are localized EN/JA via the i18n dictionary.
Component tests assert the SVG + table render and the table values match the chart data; the prob chart appears only for predictable seasons.
